summary: Umpqua NF lookout site, Douglas County, OR: tree platform 1931, L-4 cab 1933, tower 1954 or 1970 (sources disagree); now gone. Site today not described.

facts.status_note: Register says now gone; no source describes what remains on the summit today

staffing.status: Forest Service lookout named in a 1941 newspaper item

events.note: First used as an emergency lookout with a compass (Oregon Lookouts only)
Lookout stationed atop a 50-foot tree, c.1925 (Oregon Lookouts only)
Tree platform built; the register and firelookout.com say it was still there in the 1980s
L-4 lookout cab or house built
Chester Morgan named as the Forest Service lookout on Collins Butte during the past season, per a September 3, 1941 newspaper item quoted on Oregon Lookouts
New lookout tower and cab erected, c.1954 (Oregon Lookouts only; conflicts with the 1970 tower date)
Wooden tower constructed (register and firelookout.com; Oregon Lookouts gives c.1954)
Used for emergencies in the 1970s; the year given is the start of the decade, not a single date

corrections.why: The only height figure in the sources is a 50-foot tree stand from c.1925, which is 15.2 m. No source gives a tower or cab height.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Oregon Lookouts gives an emergency lookout in 1914 and a lookout in a 50-foot tree around 1925; the register and firelookout.com give a tree platform built in 1931. Not reconciled; the story reports both.
Oregon Lookouts dates a new tower and cab to about 1954; the register and firelookout.com date a wooden tower to 1970. Sources disagree and the story says so.

sources.title: Collins Mountain Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites Register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 15.2 is the 50-foot tree, not a tower; see corrections. Dates for the first structure and the later tower conflict across sources and the story says so; the Oregon Lookouts page is a compiled secondary source quoting newspapers and an administrative record that were not opened. Brief access unknown; no access level set because no source covers access today. No photo added: the cached pages give no direct image URL. Firelookout.com credits a U.S. Forest Service photo and firetower.org credits a 1946 photo from the Rex Kamstra collection; neither image URL was retrieved.
